hero.title: Scenic Mekong River Cruises
hero.subtitle: Floating Communities, Ancient Temples & All-Inclusive Luxury in Vietnam & Cambodia
paragraphs: A Scenic Mekong River Cruise offers a very different experience from Scenic's European river journeys. Instead of vineyards, medieval castles, and European capitals, the Mekong introduces travelers to Vietnamese and Cambodian culture, floating communities, temples, markets, and some of Southeast Asia's most fascinating destinations.

A Mekong itinerary can combine a luxury river cruise with land experiences in Vietnam, Cambodia, Ho Chi Minh City, the Mekong Delta, Phnom Penh, Cambodian villages, Siem Reap, and Angkor. For travelers who want more than a conventional Southeast Asia tour, the Mekong offers a way to slow down and experience the region from the river. The journey is as much about people and culture as it is about destinations.

quickAnswer.title: Is a Scenic Mekong River Cruise Worth It? The Quick Answer
storyParagraphs: Yes specially for travelers who want a luxury introduction to Vietnam and Cambodia while experiencing destinations and communities that are difficult to appreciate on a conventional city-based itinerary.

The strongest reasons to choose a Mekong cruise include Southeast Asian culture, luxury river travel, Vietnam, Cambodia, temples and history, local cuisine, Mekong Delta landscapes, and rural communities.
Mekong highlights include Ho Chi Minh City, the Mekong Delta, Phnom Penh, Cambodian villages, Siem Reap, Angkor, and Vietnamese and Cambodian cuisine.

whyChoose.heading: Why Choose a Scenic Mekong River Cruise?
paragraphs: The Mekong is fundamentally different from Europe's major rivers. A European river cruise often focuses on historic cities and monuments. The Mekong experience is much more about culture, people, landscapes, food, history, and everyday life.

The river provides access to rural areas and communities that can be difficult to experience when traveling only between major cities. Instead of constantly changing hotels, travelers can enjoy a luxury ship while exploring different parts of Vietnam and Cambodia.
whyChoose.badgeDescription: Instead of constantly changing hotels, travelers can enjoy a luxury ship while exploring different parts of Vietnam and Cambodia.

bestItineraries.title: Best Scenic Mekong River Cruise Itineraries
bestItineraries.subtitle: There isn't one perfect Mekong itinerary. The best option depends on whether your priority is Vietnam, Cambodia, culture, food, history, Angkor, river cruising, or a longer land experience.

items.title: Vietnam & Cambodia Combination
items.desc: For first-time travelers, a journey combining Vietnam and Cambodia is usually the strongest introduction. It allows you to experience both countries rather than focusing exclusively on the river.

items.title: Mekong Delta-Focused Experience
items.desc: Travelers particularly interested in Vietnam may prefer an itinerary with greater emphasis on the Mekong Delta, floating markets, and rural community life.

items.title: Mekong + Siem Reap & Angkor
items.desc: For many travelers, this is the most compelling combination. You experience the river and then continue into Cambodia's ancient cultural heritage and temple complexes.

items: The Mekong is particularly rewarding for photographers.
